desc: Co-op: player 2's partner hops onto a table and off. Rogueport's plaza, Mario put at 130 0 235 (beside the gallows' wooden platform, y 30, the playtest's photo); player 2 takes Goombella and hops left until she lands on the platform, along it, then hops off toward the gallows. Each hop lands and she stands or walks again (not left in the jump pose). Shots: on_table, off_table
